text: Hey guys, this is part 1 of the video where I translate what women say. Here we will have 3 different situations with things girls can text you, and a translation of what they actually mean, plus what you should do in that situation. Situation 1. Imagine you text a girl, but you get no reply, or in other words, she goes to you. Translation from a woman's perspective is following, you are so unimportant to me that I don't even want to open your message. What to do in that situation? Move on, no chasing, have other options. Situation 2. You text a girl, and she replies, I am busy with no details. Translation, you do not interest me. What to do? You can still ask her when she is free, and try to ask her out, but if she is vague again, you walk away. If she tells you she is busy but provides details, and maybe even options to meet at other time, that is no problem, set the date, and go meet her. In situation 3, you ask to meet the girl, and she responds with, let's meet but only as friends. Translation, I am kinda curious, but not that much into you yet. What to do? You still go meet her, but you act like it's a date. You flirt, you play the game, and if you play your cards right, she might see you as not just a friend.
